title: Account Coordinator
description:
As an Account Coordinator, you will be the backbone of our daily account management operations, ensuring everything runs smoothly for our clients and our team. We are looking for someone who doesn't just check tasks off a list, but who truly cares about the work, owns their responsibilities from start to finish, and takes real accountability.

The Account Coordinator supports the account management team in ensuring smooth operations for our clients. This role assists in the day-to-day management of the clients local marketing and advertising business activity for the local Business Unit.

This is a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly. If you are highly observant, naturally solution-oriented and eager to learn, this role offers an incredible blueprint for you to grow, add value and build your career within our full-service agency team.

Our client is based in New England. The team works primarily in a remote model with some in-person meetings and travel around the region. We will require occasional weekend hours to supervise events and activations across New England. 

The ideal candidate lives in MA, CT or RI and loves New England culture.


Key Responsibilities

Campaign & Creative Support

  • Creative job support: Support Account Team in creative campaign development, budget tracking and talent cycle management, Open job orders, submit change orders, 
  • Traffic creative assets: Traffic creative assets to media vendors (Broadcast, Digital, OOH) to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time, following appropriate process and protocols.
  • Merchandising/ Point of Purchase:
    • Build monthly restaurant guides and schematics to train personnel to execute strategy.
    • Assist in creative development of merchandising and signage elements
    • Upload digital menu board elements for deployment 

Client & Meeting Logistics

  • Support meeting execution: Coordinate client meetings from venue setup and communication protocols to preparing materials and handling day-of logistics as directed by Manager.
  • Manage documentation: Take ownership of client status invitations, agendas, official meeting minutes, conference reports, etc. following standard protocols for client approval as directed by Manager.
  • Manage Client communication:
    • Manage the official client email inbox, draft scheduled communications and coordinate details across internal departments.
    • Develop and distribute monthly recap emails to client showcasing the recent work provided by the Agency.

 Administrative and Operational Support

  • Submit weekly invoices for budget tracking
  • Ownership of keeping documentation up-to-date, such as client distribution lists, attendance sheets, etc.
  • Competitive market research as directed

Local Activation

  • Support Event Execution: Collaborate with vendors, media/ PR partners and the broader to team to order materials, secure venues, manage logistics, etc.. for social media brand events across the region
  • Travel locally: Travel within New England for in-person client meetings and event execution as needed.

What We Are Looking For

  • An Ownership Mindset: You take pride in your work, see projects through from initiation to completion and hold yourself accountable to deadlines.
  • Resourceful Problem-Solver: You are observant, proactive, and bring thoughtful, forward-thinking solutions to the management team rather than just pointing out issues.
  • Eager Learner: You recognize you have a lot to learn and are excited to do it. You absorb feedback well and view mistakes as opportunities to improve and grow into working with increasingly less direct supervision.
  • Strong Communicator: You have excellent interpersonal skills and can confidently and professionally connect with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Adaptable Team Player: You know how to motivate yourself and others, stay organized when handling multiple tasks, and maintain a high level of attention to detail even when workloads fluctuate.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, or a related field preferred 
  • Prior internship or relevant agency/marketing experience is a plus.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

title: Multicultural Integrated Media Planner
description:
Manages the day-to-day process of all media planning efforts for multicultural segments. Also, supports the development, execution, and optimization of integrated media plans across channels, using audience, market, and media insights to inform strategic recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of media objectives, strategies, tactics, channel selection, and prioritization.
  • Research and synthesize consumer, market, category, and media data to inform media planning recommendations.
  • Assist in the development of target audience profiles, local market insights, and trend analyses.
  • Help establish communication goals by media channel and across the full integrated media plan.
  • Evaluate media opportunities to determine strategic fit, plan application, and implementation needs.
  • Create and maintain planning documents, including flowcharts, budgets, program POVs, market landscapes, and related materials.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure planning deliverables are accurate, timely, and aligned with client expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • 4-year college degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field.
  • 2-3 years of media planning experience.
  • Strong understanding of media fundamentals and integrated planning principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and adapt in a fast-paced agency environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Media Ocean/Prisma and MediaTools.
  • Strong presentation skills.
  • Exposure to multicultural media planning.

Work Environment

This role is based in the Los Angeles office. The position may require collaboration across teams in different markets, with expectations for timely communication, accurate documentation, and proactive ownership of assigned planning tasks.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and scope of work for this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, or qualifications required.

title: Integrated Senior Media Planner
description:
Manages the day-to-day process of all media planning efforts for Clients of responsibility.

Responsibilities 

  • Implements the process and assists with the management of the strategic and tactical execution of all media products for Clients of responsibility. 
  • Confers with Media Director, Clients, and/or Account Services to establish media objectives, and strategies for advertising campaigns.
  • Presents media plans to Media Director, Account Services and Client for approval and makes adjustments as necessary. 
  • Writes plan presentations. 
  • Recommend, evaluate and integrate emerging media opportunities.
  • Write POV’s.
  • Demonstrate a complete understanding of the Client’s business.
  • Implements the management of daily tasks in support of the media product.
  • Maintain budget control and ensure execution of media plans by authorizing approved media schedules and monitoring buys/schedules.
  • Foster a good working relationship with account and client teams to facilitate flawless execution of plans.
  • Evaluates composition of a wide range of media vehicles to determine which would most effectively reach the target audience.
  • Calculates reach and frequency of potential media vehicles.
  • Confers with media representatives to evaluate best placement.
  • Gathers statistics and prepares media plans with directives to guide the buying process.
  • Studies demographic data and consumer profiles to identify desired target audiences for print, broadcast, or online advertising.
  • Keeps current on media trends.
  • Responsible for developing the skill and knowledge base of those more junior as well as supervise, advise and counsel group in all daily activities.
  • Motivate Planners and encourage innovation and creativity throughout all projects by serving as a role model within the group/team.
  • Lead team in setting strategies for developing media plans.

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.A.) from a four-year college or university required.
  • 5 + years of Media Planning experience required.
  • QSR and Automotive is a plus.
  • Media Channel knowledge of TV, radio, OTT, CTV, streaming audio, OOH and direct mail.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Power Point and Excel.
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
  • Strong mathematical abilities required.
  • Detail oriented with exceptional curiosity, critical thinking and solution driven capabilities.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks required.
  • Strong presentation skills preferred.
  • Excellent time-management skills.

title: Copywriter
description:
We're looking for a copywriter to craft imaginative, persuasive campaigns for Asian American and Asian audiences, reporting to our Creative Director. This role calls for genuine cultural insight into Asian American or Asian communities — through lived experience, community immersion, or comparable background — to keep messaging authentic and resonant.

What You'll Do

  • Write clear, original, on-brand copy across TV, social, print, radio, and digital

  • Bring cultural fluency to shape tone, messaging, and creative strategy for Asian market audiences

  • Collaborate with the Art Director on layouts and storyboards

  • Proof and check mechanicals for accuracy

  • Stay current on trends — cultural and technological — shaping the space

What You Bring

  • Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills

  • Deep insight into Asian American or Asian consumer values and lifestyle

  • Strong conceptual thinking and multi-channel writing experience

  • Great communication skills and attention to detail

  • Strong organization and time management; able to juggle multiple projects

  • Bilingual (Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean, Vietnamese, Tagalog, etc.) a plus — not required
